subject: Money
title: Payroll Tax
description: A micro-lesson that makes Payroll Tax usable.

hook.text: Before you see your paycheck, 7.65% vanishes. Your employer pays another 7.65%. That's 15.3% gone.

buildup.text: Payroll taxes fund Social Security (6.2%) and Medicare (1.45%). They're separate from income tax.

discovery.text: Social Security tax caps at $160,000. Earn more and the extra isn't taxed. This makes it regressive.

twist.text: Self-employed people pay both halves: the full 15.3%. No employer to split the cost with.

climax.text: Payroll tax is the largest tax most Americans pay, yet few understand what it funds or how it works.

punchline.text: The invisible tax is the biggest one.

quiz.question: What do payroll taxes primarily fund?
